The conjecture is true! Here is a proof.

Axiom 1 (a1): X = op(X, op(op(X, op(X, Y)), Z)).

= { by axiom 1 (a1) }
  op(x0, op(op(x0, op(x0, op(x0, X))), op(x1, op(x2, x2))))
= { by axiom 1 (a1) }
  op(x0, op(op(x0, op(op(x0, op(x0, X)), op(op(op(x0, op(x0, X)), op(op(x0, op(x0, X)), Y)), Z))), op(x1, op(x2, x2)))) (peak)

  op(x0, op(x0, op(x1, op(x2, x2))))

RESULT: Theorem (the conjecture is true).
